summary: Iteration 76: Tested new Gallery ShareRow (Google / Insta / WhatsApp) + AI Promo Generator + same-day confirm. Backend regression /api/gallery/generate returned a proper branded flyer with rich hashtagged post_caption (pytest PASSED in ~16s — cached image reuse or fast run). Frontend all flows PASS: 3 image items rendered with share row + AI badge; share buttons clickable; Google/Insta fallback → window.open + clipboard populated with the LLM caption (hashtags intact); WhatsApp opened wa.me?text=... with caption + backend file url; same-day Mira confirm dialog appeared with '[QA-SIM]' after seeding social_posts and after accept, business.google.com opened (auto-post fallback = expected in preview). Regression: upload/copy/download/delete buttons all render.

issues: Input value gets cleared / element 'not stable' with fast automated fills. Real users are fine, but automated tests need wait_for_load_state('networkidle') + ~2s settle before fill. Recommend removing the animated re-render on first paint if possible.
Recharts warning: 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' (some chart container has 0 dimensions at initial render).
Hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' still present (MiraDayOffer.jsx — flagged since iter 75).

action_items: Non-blocking: fix MiraDayOffer.jsx invalid <span> inside <option> (persistent hydration warning).
Non-blocking: fix Recharts container width/height=0 warning on dashboard mount.
critical_code_review_comments: Gallery.jsx ShareRow: post_caption fallback chain (m.post_caption || m.caption || generic) is fine, but consider trimming the WhatsApp url to backend/api/files path rather than full url with double-slash — currently produces `${BACKEND_URL}${m.url}` where m.url starts with `/api/files/...` — works but the wa.me link is 250+ chars.

Gallery.jsx: three async click handlers all setPosting(null) in finally — good. But `disabled={!!posting}` on WhatsApp button prevents WA share while Google/Insta network calls are in flight — arguably intended (single-flight) but the WhatsApp path is client-only and could be always enabled.
Gallery.jsx generate() uses timeout: 120000 but backend can take 60–180s for image gen — bump to 240000 (or backend to trim time) so the toast 'Generation failed' doesn't fire on slow LLM runs.
Design: `[10px]` font size on share buttons is on the border of readability (screenshot shows Google/Insta/WhatsApp text still legible on 1920, but on mobile 390px it will crunch).
seed_data_creation: Inserted 1 social_posts doc {caption:'Morning offer [QA-SIM]', platforms:['google'], kind:'google_offer', results.google.ok:true, created_at:<iso today>} for tenant 83ab97b6-b481-4172-afd7-53a46c93317d. DELETED after test (deleted_count=1, remaining google_today=0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form quirk: on first paint the email input remounts (animated bg) — a plain page.fill immediately after wait_for_selector sometimes silently succeeds but the input clears on the next React render. Fix: `await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')` + `await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)` BEFORE `page.locator('input[type=email]').fill(...)`. Sonner toasts are not caught by `[data-sonner-toast]` / `[role=status]` selectors reliably during click flow — verify success by observing window.open() calls + navigator.clipboard patched writeText instead. To patch clipboard, use `Object.defineProperty(navigator,'clipboard',{value:{writeText: async t => window.__clip=t}, configurable:true})` — do NOT call the real writeText (throws NotAllowedError in headless). Seed doc for same-day google confirm: created_at MUST be ISO string (Python datetime → server TypeError). Cleanup DONE.
